bibliography.title: Speculative Actions: A Lossless Framework for Faster Agentic Systems

abstract_sentences.text: AI agents are increasingly deployed in complex, interactive environments, yet their runtime remains a major bottleneck for training, evaluation, and real-world use.
Typical agent behavior unfolds sequentially, where each action requires an API call that can incur substantial latency.

evidence.anchor: each action requires an API call

abstract_sentences.text: For example, a game of chess between two state-of-the-art agents can take hours.

evidence.anchor: a game of chess ... can take hours

abstract_sentences.text: We introduce speculative actions, a lossless acceleration framework for general agentic systems.

Inspired by speculative execution in microprocessors and speculative decoding in LLM inference, our method uses faster models to predict likely future actions and executes them in parallel, committing only when predictions match.
We evaluate speculative actions across gaming, e-commerce, and web search environments, and additionally study a lossy extension in an operating systems setting.

evidence.anchor: a lossy extension in an operating systems setting

abstract_sentences.text: Across domains, we achieve up to 55% next-action prediction accuracy, translating into substantial latency reductions.
Finally, we present a cost–latency analysis that formalizes the tradeoff between speculative breadth and time savings.
This analysis enables principled tuning and selective branch launching, to ensure multi-branch speculation delivers practical speedups without prohibitive cost growth.

evidence.anchor: practical speedups without prohibitive cost growth

final_judgment.single_storyline: 把 agent 的顺序 API 等待重写成慢而权威的 Actor 与快而不权威的 Speculator 并行追赶；cache hit、验证提交和可回滚 safety envelope 将 idle waiting 转成 productive work（p.2、p.4–5、p.9–10）。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 Actor/Speculator 角色、Figure 1、Algorithm 1、Assumptions 1–2、Proposition 1 的 50% ceiling、四环境主要 accuracy/latency/cost 数字、Theorem 3 的 threshold 结构和 Figure 6 Pareto 对照。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Proof、tau-bench 任务/API 构成、HotpotQA strict matching、OS hardware/prompt/context、Figure 7–9、Table 2/3、Theorem 3/6 derivations 移入 Appendix A–C；这使正文决策足够但复现与安全审查依赖附录。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 1 与 Algorithm 1 共用 Actor/Speculator/cache/validation 词汇；Figure 2–4 测 prediction，Figure 5–6 测 latency/convergence/cost，theorem formula 以 p(k)、k 连接 mechanism→prediction→result→tuning。
final_judgment.largest_gap: lossless 依赖可逆/无副作用和分布假设，未在真实 irreversible API 上做轨迹审计；跨域分母、seed、error-bar 定义不完整；Theorem 6 无实验，Theorem 3 仅有 threshold approximation，OS cost 依赖单 workload 的 convergence-stop rule。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 先把权威结果、预测角色和错误分支撤销方式写成统一状态/API 语义，再让每个可证伪参数（p(k)、k、latency、cost）对应机制图、对照结果和安全/停止条件（p.4–5、p.9–10）。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 只适用于可并发、幂等/可回滚/沙箱化且最终有 authoritative validation 的环境；对不可逆 side effect 或 last-write-wins 的 lossy system，须改写为独立 reactive-performance 主张（p.5、p.8、p.16）。
